nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (1-5min)
nodes.notes: Per design.md D2: n8n stays cron+fetch only, no RDF-ification. Cadence (2min here, tune 1-5min per PRD) is INTENTIONALLY finer than the 1h candle beta most ticks land on an in-progress candle. That is expected and safe: docs/architecture-notes.md documents that runCycle is a pure function of its input candles (no wall-clock reads), so repeated /api/cycle calls against an unchanged/in-progress candle are idempotent no-ops (tests/cycle/idempotency.test.ts), not a bug to engineer around with cadence alignment.

nodes.name: Fetch Klines - BTCUSDT
nodes.notes: Raw fetch only (D2) - one HTTP Request node per allowlisted asset (src/market/assets.ts), limit=50 to match the system's uniform per-cycle window (see design.md 'Why 50').

nodes.name: Aggregate (build /api/cycle payload)
nodes.notes: Only reshapes raw Binance kline arrays [openTime,open,high,low,close,volume,...] into the Candle[] shape app/api/cycle/route.ts expects ({symbol, klines:[{openTime,open,high,low,close,volume}]}). No RDF, no indicator math, no decision logic here - all of that stays server-side (D2).

nodes.name: POST /api/cycle
nodes.notes: T-2 (design.md Threat Matrix): shared-secret header must match FAF_CYCLE_SHARED_SECRET (see .env.example) configured on the app deployment. Store the secret in an n8n credential/environment variable, never hardcoded in the workflow JSON.
